reason: The README describes GrassVision as a server-side API proxy that adds image analysis, structured visual evidence, caching, and image-processing features to text-only language models through compatible chat protocols.

summaries.zh: GrassVision 是一个兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Responses 协议的视觉代理服务，可将图片分析结果、像素证据和缓存能力接入纯文本大模型。
summaries.en: GrassVision is an API proxy compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Responses protocols that adds image analysis, pixel evidence, and caching to text-only language models.

capabilities: Proxies OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and Responses API requests
Sends supplied images to configured vision providers for analysis
Stores image analysis results in a persistent cache
Provides an administrative interface for configuring providers, models, prompts, and settings
Performs local image processing including cropping, pixel analysis, OCR-related slicing, and SVG primitive detection
